skill.name: weibo-comment-insights
skill.description: Retrieve Weibo comments and replies through SocialDataX, then summarize feedback themes, pain points, purchase concerns, unmet needs, and FAQs.
skill.summary: Turn retrieved Weibo comments into evidence-based research findings and practical recommendations.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: All 43 static alerts are false positives involving Markdown, ordinary Chinese prose, documented credentials, informational links, or Weibo identifiers. A separate supply-chain risk exists because CLI examples execute an unpinned npm package using npx -y. No evidence found of embedded credentials, malicious exfiltration, or prompt injection in the supplied files; the external package implementation was not audited.

remediation.issue: CLI examples execute socialdatax-skills@latest with automatic installation confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Replace @latest with a reviewed exact version, install through a lockfile with integrity verification, and obtain approval before package execution.

content.user_title: Analyze Weibo Comments for Customer Insights
content.value_statement: Weibo feedback can be difficult to organize into clear research findings. This skill guides SocialDataX retrieval and turns returned comments into evidence-based themes and recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Guide comment retrieval from a Weibo post ID, URL, short link, or share text through the SocialDataX CLI.
Retrieve replies using a known post ID and comment ID.
Select hot or newest-first comment sorting and continue with returned pagination tokens.
Bound retrieval with page or item limits and preserve partial results during recovery.
Organize visible feedback into themes, pain points, purchase concerns, unmet needs, FAQs, and recommended actions.
Separate quoted comment evidence from interpretation and report the retrieved sample scope.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key, network access, and sufficient service balance; direct CLI execution also requires Node.js and npm.
The supplied files contain instructions, not the CLI implementation; external package behavior was not audited.
Findings cover only returned comments and replies; empty pagination tokens do not prove complete retrieval.
The workflow is read-only and does not log in, publish posts, like content, submit comments, or modify accounts.

use_cases.title: Plan Follow-Up Content
use_cases.description: Group returned audience questions and discussion themes into follow-up topics, with visible comment evidence.

use_cases.title: Discover Product Friction
use_cases.description: Identify pain points, unmet needs, and purchase concerns from comments under a specified product post.

use_cases.title: Prepare Customer FAQs
use_cases.description: Extract recurring questions and reply-thread concerns into FAQ topics and recommended support actions.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize One Comment Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the first comment page for [Weibo post URL]. Summarize major themes and quote only visible comments. State the sample scope.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: review feedback from a single post.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Purchase Concerns
prompt_templates.prompt: For [post ID], retrieve at most 100 comments. Group pain points and purchase concerns, cite visible evidence, and suggest FAQ topics.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: turn a bounded sample into practical research findings.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate a Reply Thread
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve up to two reply pages for post [post ID], comment [comment ID]. Separate original comments, replies, evidence, and interpretation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: investigate a specific discussion without implying complete coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Resume Partial Research
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume [partial result] for [post ID] using its nonempty next-page token. Preserve sorting and remaining limits. Report unmet needs and coverage gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: recover a bounded retrieval and produce an evidence-based research brief.

output_examples.input: Illustrative sample: three visible comments ask about delivery timing. Summarize the theme and propose an action.
output: Scope: Three supplied comments; no replies or additional pages were reviewed.
Theme: Delivery timing is a recurring question in this sample.
Action: Prepare a delivery FAQ using verified shipping information.

output_examples.input: Illustrative sample: one returned comment says, 'Does this work with older models?' Extract a research finding.
output: Evidence: 'Does this work with older models?'
Interpretation: This commenter needs clearer compatibility information.
Action: Add verified compatibility details to the FAQ.
Limitation: One comment does not establish how common this concern is.

best_practices: Start with one page and set explicit page or item limits before expanding retrieval.
Preserve complete pagination tokens and sorting settings; keep API keys out of prompts and published reports.
Quote only returned comments, separate evidence from interpretation, and disclose sample scope and incomplete replies.
anti_patterns: Treating a first-page sample or an empty pagination token as proof of complete Weibo coverage.
Inventing comments, inferring platform-wide prevalence, or presenting interpretation as direct evidence.
Automatically rerunning partial retrievals from the beginning or using unlimited pagination without an agreed retrieval budget.

faq.question: Which inputs are supported?
faq.answer: Use a Weibo post ID, post URL, short link, or share text. Reply retrieval requires both post and comment IDs.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and ensure service balance and network access. The direct CLI requires Node.js and npm; configured MCP tools are another option.

faq.question: Does this skill change my Weibo account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only. It does not log in, post, like, comment, or modify accounts.

faq.question: Can I retrieve every comment?
faq.answer: You can request additional pages while a next-page token exists. An empty token does not guarantee every comment or reply was retrieved.

faq.question: How should partial results be handled?
faq.answer: Keep retrieved items and errors. Resume with a nonempty continuation token and remaining limits; do not automatically restart from the first page.

faq.question: Are the command examples version-pinned?
faq.answer: No. They use socialdatax-skills@latest with automatic installation confirmation. Review and pin the package before granting execution access.
